history.summary: An efficient 958 sqft 99-year 3BR at Treasure Crest (a 2018 EC) in D19 Sengkang at $1.53M ($1,597 PSF), just 180m from Cheng Lim LRT. Well-sized, newish, large-development EC at an accessible quantum — the cleanest value profile in a weak batch, though appreciation upside is EC-capped.
history.rating_rationale: Treasure Crest is a large former Executive Condo (well over 500 units) in Sengkang, 180m from Cheng Lim LRT, with an efficient 958 sqft 3BR at a sensible $1.53M / $1,597 PSF — comfortably in the deep HDB-upgrader demand band. High score_1000 (636) and cost-frontier status reflect good value-for-price. The offsetting factors are LRT-only access, an EC's appreciation ceiling, and no URA data to confirm the trend. The best risk-reward in the batch but still a measured Neutral given OCR/EC ceiling.
red_flags: Former EC — appreciation tends to plateau after privatisation gains
No URA appreciation/txn data; arena record sub-.500 (281-284)
catalysts: Large-development EC — strong liquidity and broad upgrader buyer pool
180m to Cheng Lim LRT — rare immediate transit access
Efficient 958 sqft 3BR at $1.53M — deep-demand quantum and good value-for-price (score 636, on frontier)
